description: Country record from Voidly's OONI-based censorship index: risk level and score from the OONI anomaly rate, measurement count, the OONI tests showing anomalies (affectedServices), active incidents and the source's lastUpdated time. These are measurement signals for the whole country, not per-domain block verdicts.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (e.g., IR for Iran, CN for China, RU for Russia)
